Identity: the 20-F defines 'Xiaomi Group' as 'Xiaomi Corporation (HKEx: 1810), one of our shareholders, and its subsidiaries and VIEs'. PLACEMENT IS A JUDGMENT: neocloud.json has no application-layer or end-customer sector, and the edge requires the player in the same chain; proposed application / 'AI-Native Vertical Apps' (an existing sector name in nvidia_vera_rubin.json / nvda_b200.json, new to neocloud.json). The only in-chain customer sector, ai_models / Foundation Models, would claim a model-developer role that no source here states. contracts.signal: Related-party revenue from Xiaomi Group (Xiaomi Corporation, HKEx: 1810, a shareholder; 20-F): public cloud services provided to Xiaomi Group RMB 1,853,124 thousand in 2025 (RMB 1,091,451 thousand in 2024; RMB 763,338 thousand in 2023) and enterprise cloud services provided to Xiaomi Group RMB 382,438 thousand in 2025 (RMB 182,364 thousand in 2024; RMB 104,967 thousand in 2023).
